description: Clover Lens recruitment skills ontology covering technical skills, frameworks, libraries, developer tools, enterprise applications, databases, cloud services, engineering software, healthcare systems, finance platforms, HR/recruitment applications, marketing tools, project/product tools, and soft skills. Designed for resume/JD parsing, normalization, matching, and ranking.
ambiguity_policy: Case-insensitive NFKC normalization. Prefer exact canonical matches and curated aliases. Require surrounding technical context for ambiguous one-token terms such as R, C, Go, Java, Spring and AWS. Negative-context rules reduce false positives from ordinary language or non-technical meanings.

reference_frameworks.name: ESCO
reference_frameworks.usage: Reference taxonomy structure and occupational-skill semantics; this dataset is a Clover Lens curated ontology, not a verbatim ESCO export.

reference_frameworks.name: O*NET
reference_frameworks.usage: Reference for employer-relevant software/technology and occupational concepts; this dataset is a Clover Lens curated ontology, not a verbatim O*NET export.
